burrata.name: Burrata & heirloom utamatisi
burrata.short: I-burrata enokhilimu, utamatisi ovuthiwe, inhlama emuncu eyosiwe.
burrata.description: Ibhola elithambile le-burrata elisha, utamatisi omnandi we-heirloom kanye ne-basil, eqedwe ngamafutha omnqumo. Yifake ngenhlama emuncu eyosiwe efudumele.
burrata.ingredients: Burrata (ubisi), utamatisi, basil, amafutha omnqumo, inhlama emuncu (ukolweni), usawoti olwandle.

dumplings.name: Amadombolo a-Chili-crisp
dumplings.short: Amadombolo emifino yegolide, amafutha e-chili, ama-scallions.
dumplings.description: Amadombolo emifino afakwe epanini ayisithupha anezansi ezicwebile nendawo ethambile. Kuqedwe ngamafutha e-chili nama-scallions, ne-soy dipping sauce eceleni.
dumplings.ingredients: I-wrappers kakolweni, iklabishi, amakhowe, isanqante, ama-scallions, i-soy sauce (i-soy, ukolweni), i-sesame, i-chili oil.

pasta.name: Utamatisi & basil rigatoni
pasta.short: Utamatisi othosiwe kancane, i-basil entsha, i-parmesan.
pasta.description: I-pasta egobile ijikijelwe kusoso katamatisi ecebile, ethosiwe kancane, ne-basil entsha ne-parmesan yemifino. Iyaduduza, ilula, futhi yenzelwe isidlo sasemini eside.
pasta.ingredients: I-Rigatoni (ukolweni), utamatisi, i-basil, i-parmesan yemifino (ubisi), amafutha omnqumo, i-garlic.

salad.name: Isitsha sengadi esigazingiwe
salad.description: Ama-beet athosiwe kanye nobhatata phezu kwemifino epholile, namatshwele, amawolintshi agqamile namakhambi amasha. Ukugqoka kukalamula kuhlanganisa konke.
salad.ingredients: Ama-beet, ubhatata, uphizi, ama-citrus, imifino, iparsley, i-mint, isesame, ilamula, amafutha omnqumo.

chicken.name: Inkukhu ye-Lemon & herb
chicken.short: Inkukhu yegolide, amazambane amantombazane, ubhontshisi oluhlaza.
chicken.description: Inkukhu ethosiwe ngamakhambi enesikhumba esicwebile, amazambane amantombazane kanye nobhontshisi oluhlaza. Ifakwe nge-lemon elula namafutha omnqumo.
chicken.ingredients: Inkukhu, amazambane, ubhontshisi oluhlaza, ilamula, amafutha omnqumo, i-rosemary, i-thyme, i-garlic.

cake.name: Ikhekhe le-chocolate ye-ganache
cake.short: Ushokoledi omnyama, ukhilimu we-vanilla, okusajingijolo okusha.
cake.description: Ucezu olucebile lwekhekhe lesendlalelo sikashokoledi eline-ganache kashokoledi omnyama ocwebezelayo. Ukhilimu omncane we-vanilla kanye nokusajingijolo okusha ohlangothini.
cake.ingredients: Ushokoledi, ufulawa kakolweni, amaqanda, ibhotela (ubisi), ukhilimu (ubisi), ushukela, i-vanilla, okusajingijolo.

lemonade.name: I-Strawberry basil lemonade
lemonade.short: Ama-strawberry amasha, ulamula, i-basil namanzi acwebile.
lemonade.description: I-lemonade ekhanyayo, ecwebezelayo enamasitrobheni amasha, ukuminya kukalamula kanye ne-basil enephunga elimnandi. Wakhonza phezu kweqhwa.
lemonade.ingredients: I-Strawberry, ilamula, i-basil, ushukela womoba, amanzi acwebile, iqhwa.

tea.name: I-Jasmine itiye elibandayo
tea.short: Itiye le-jasmine lezimbali, ilamula, iqhwa eliningi.
tea.description: Itiye le-jasmine elisanda kuphekwa, lipholile futhi lanikezwa phezu kweqhwa elinolamula. Ayinaswidi, enezimbali ezithambile.
tea.ingredients: Itiye le-jasmine, ilamula, amanzi ahlungiwe, iqhwa. Iqukethe i-caffeine.
